_doc: One entry per trained model; src/train.py --config <name> runs hlab.train.fit with it. Keys: dataset (hlab.datasets name), split, holdout (type random_frames|flights, seed, fraction), loss (mse|masked_mse), lr, clip (null = none), seed (null = unseeded torch), epochs, batch, patience, final (best|last), log (file under results/). v2, pv and pv_om reproduce the deleted train_autoencoder*.py scripts exactly; india and india_temp mirror the untracked train_autoencoder_india*.py recipe and are unverified until those scripts are committed.

v2.note: Multi-equipment baseline on all five healthy folders (Track A). Recorded run: best val_loss 0.005830 at epoch 50.

pv.note: PV specialist on O&M + THM healthy frames (HER-89). Val seed 43 is distinct from the preprocess split seed 42. Recorded run: best val_loss 0.016995 at epoch 5.

pv_om.note: PV specialist on O&M healthy frames only (HER-114 retrain). Recorded run: best val_loss 0.011258 at epoch 10.

india.note: Thermal-Library India plot 17 (milestone 06, HER-106 recipe: lr 3e-4 + clip 1.0, whole-flight holdout). Mirrors the untracked train_autoencoder_india.py; unverified.

india_temp.note: Same recipe on degrees-C input (HER-82). Mirrors the untracked train_autoencoder_india_temp.py; unverified. The panel-masked and inpainting variants need their input blanking step and stay in their scripts.
